_doc: Symptom card body sites (docs/design/symptom-context-card.md section 5). Generic defaults; a records repo may replace or add sites by id in config/symptom-card.json. triggers match the lower-cased symptom text at a word start; label_terms match label sections at word boundaries; at most 5 questions; closing: better within better_days, else after max_days the tier applies.

sites.name: eyes
questions: Any blurring or change in sight?
sites.before_using: Eye drops: ask a doctor before using any.

sites.name: head
questions: Where is the headache: front, side, back or all over?
Did it start suddenly or slowly?
Any vomiting, or trouble with the eyes or speech?
sites.before_using: Painkillers: ask a doctor before taking any.

sites.name: chest
questions: Where is the pain, and does it go to the arm, neck or jaw?
How long does it last each time?
Does it come on walking, or at rest?
Any sweating, breathlessness or feeling faint with it?
sites.before_using: Painkillers or balms: ask a doctor before using any.

sites.name: stomach
questions: Where in the stomach: upper, lower or one side?
How many times loose motions or vomiting today?
Drinking water and passing urine as usual?
sites.before_using: Medicines for the stomach or loose motions: ask a doctor before taking any.

sites.name: skin
questions: Where is the rash or mark?
Any swelling of the lips or face?
Any new soap, cream or food?
sites.before_using: Creams or tablets for the skin: ask a doctor before using any.

sites.name: arms, legs, speech or balance
questions: Which side: left, right or both?
Any change in speech or in the face?
sites.before_using: Painkillers or balms: ask a doctor before using any.

sites.name: breathing
questions: Breathless at rest, or only when walking?
Can lie flat without extra pillows?
Any cough, and any blood in it?
sites.before_using: Cough syrups or inhalers not prescribed: ask a doctor before using any.

sites.name: urine
questions: Burning or pain while passing urine?
Any blood or dark colour in the urine?

sites.name: dizziness
questions: Does the room spin, or does it feel light-headed?
Does it come on standing up?
BP and pulse at the time, if measured?
